text:
sara: Quick sync post-RFC: two open items - actor provenance across proxies and the minimal telemetry payload for post-incident queries.

ned: For provenance, don't bloat top-level telemetry. Emit a prov_token (sha256 of chain) + chain_len. Full actor_chain stored in TTLed audit store only.

priya: Agree. Add api_key_scope enum: global|org|project|org:project so we don't parse freeform. Keep PII out of telemetry (hash emails).

jamie: Also include decision_id (uuid) and policy_id. If a request triggers >1 check, decision_id lets us correlate.

karen: Ops: full-log all denies and any policy with tag=elevated. Base sample allows at 2%. Admin/token-exchange always 100%. Deny reason code required.

morgan: Add policy_cache_hit boolean and decision_latency_ms. That helps triage perf.

ops-bot: pipeline note: topic audits.auth.v1; adding tag auth_decision lets us route denies to hot retention topic. Will require schema bump.

sara: Draft compact payload (proto-friendly):
```
auth_decision {
  decision_id: "uuid"
  outcome: "allow"|"deny"
  ts: 1746100000
  latency_ms: 10
  policy_id: "string"
  policy_hash: "sha1"
  matched_rules: ["role_check"]
  actor_kind: "user"|"service"|"operator"
  actor_hash: "sha256"
  prov_token: "sha256"
  chain_len: 2
  api_key_scope: "project"
  org_id: "org-123"
  project_id: "proj-456"
  endpoint: "/v1/generate"
  policy_cache_hit: true
  deny_code: "ROLE_MISMATCH"
  sample_rate: 0.02
}
```

priya: middleware config suggestion: propagate: minimal by default (actor_hash+prov_token+org/project). full only for internal services.

ned: salt actor hashes per-tenant. ops: we'll manage salt via KMS and rotation policy.

sara: action items: ned drafts RFC follow-up with final schema and sampling matrix; morgan/ops to draft migration plan for topics; priya to loop legal for retention/TTL. Lock Wed. Thanks.
